description: This file manages Chrome browser automation, including launching, checking reachability, and stopping Chrome instances, with focus on integration with the Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP). It includes functions for building launch arguments, verifying WebSocket connectivity, and handling browser profiles.

classes.name: RunningChrome
classes.description: Represents a running Chrome process with associated metadata such as PID, executable info, user data directory, CDP port, start time, and process handle.

methods.name: resolveBrowserExecutable
methods.description: Resolves the browser executable path based on the resolved browser configuration and current platform.

methods.name: resolveOpenClawUserDataDir
methods.description: Returns the path to the user data directory for a given profile name.

methods.name: buildOpenClawChromeLaunchArgs
methods.description: Constructs command-line arguments for launching Chrome with specified profile and configuration.

methods.name: canOpenWebSocket
methods.description: Checks if a WebSocket URL can be opened within a specified timeout.

methods.name: isChromeReachable
methods.description: Determines if Chrome is reachable via its CDP endpoint within a timeout.

methods.name: fetchChromeVersion
methods.description: Fetches version information from Chrome's /json/version endpoint.

methods.name: getChromeWebSocketUrl
methods.description: Retrieves the WebSocket debugger URL for Chrome's CDP if available.

methods.name: canRunCdpHealthCommand
methods.description: Checks if the Chrome DevTools Protocol health command can be successfully run.

methods.name: isChromeCdpReady
methods.description: Verifies if Chrome's CDP is ready for communication.

methods.name: launchOpenClawChrome
methods.description: Launches a Chrome instance with specified configuration and profile, waits until CDP is available.

methods.name: stopOpenClawChrome
methods.description: Stops a running Chrome instance gracefully, with fallback to force kill.
